name: Wrapped iTRY
oneLiner: wiTRY is a Brix staking wrapper that accrues yield over iTRY, with exposure to Turkish-lira money-market funds and local TRY instruments.
collateral: iTRY deposited into the Brix staking wrapper, backed by regulated Turkish-lira money-market funds and related TRY cash/liquidity instruments
pegMechanism: wiTRY appreciates against iTRY as fund yield is minted into the staking contract and vests over time; users can unstake through a cooldown or use Fast Redeem for a fee, while final TRY exposure inherits iTRY issuer and local-currency risk

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Re-verified 2026-07-30 against live Brix materials: iTRY is fully backed by the Digital Liquidity Fund's DLF token, shares of a regulated basket of Turkish money-market funds with a daily NAV published by a licensed fund administrator, and wiTRY is the ERC-4626 staking wrapper whose value accrues against iTRY as fund yield is minted into the staking contract. The live stabilization and claim structure is therefore an NAV-accreting short-duration money-market-fund exposure rather than a fixed TRY cash claim, a CDP, or a private-credit fund; the tbill archetype remains the matching supported V9 category. wiTRY has no tracked parent asset (iTRY is not a Pharos-tracked coin), so no archetypeOverride parent divergence applies.
